findings.title: CANDY hook was initially placed behind an existing AppCore conditional return
findings.resolution: useCandyRuntime now runs unconditionally in AppCore's stable hook sequence. Feature-disabled behavior is internal to the hook. A focused source-order regression and real browser none-to-loaded/reload checks pass with zero React console warnings or errors.

findings.title: Free-form local model could misdescribe SSSP as a hypergraph algorithm
findings.resolution: A narrow deterministic CANDY router now answers read-only SSSP explanations and rejects Hypergraph execution before broad conversational/model routing. Live browser retest returned the contract-correct explanation and INVALID_GRAPH_TYPE with zero jobs/processes.

findings.title: CANDY submit and cancel initially shared an over-broad positive-verb authorization gate
findings.resolution: The last action boundary now requires CANDY/job context, a positively authorized clause, and the exact submit or cancel verb family. Negated, unrelated, and cross-family requests fail closed.

findings.title: Discovered capability intersection could become stale after graph-type change
findings.resolution: The hook retains the typed declaration only in memory and recomputes the frontend/runtime/authorization/active-graph intersection whenever graph type changes.

findings.title: The live model lacked bounded defaults for required CANDY resource arguments
findings.resolution: The prompt now exposes a compiled argument contract for SUBMIT_CANDY_JOB. Strict validation still decides acceptance. The repeated qwen3:8b run proposed valid submit, status, and cancellation actions with no shell/path/process fields.
